title: Informed Consent
description: The user may not be fully aware of what data is being collected by the wearable device, leading to a lack of informed consent regarding data sharing and usage.

title: Data Linkability
description: Sensor telemetry data (e.g., GPS position, heart rate) can be linked to the user, potentially allowing for tracking and identification without their consent.

title: Data Misuse
description: The wearable device may process or store the collected data in a way that could lead to unauthorized access or misuse of personal information.

title: Data Retention
description: The wearable device may retain sensor data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The wearable device may unintentionally share sensitive data (e.g., GPS traces, exercise sessions) with unauthorized parties during the sync process.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit between the wearable device and the companion app could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The companion app may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: User Misunderstanding of Data Usage
description: Users may not fully understand how their data is being used by the companion app, leading to potential misuse of their personal information.

title: Inadequate User Consent
description: The user may not fully understand what data is being collected and how it will be used, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Leakage
description: The companion app may inadvertently expose user data to unauthorized parties, either through poor security practices or vulnerabilities.

title: Improper Data Retention
description: The companion app may retain user data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Metadata Exposure
description: Data in transit may expose metadata that can be used to infer sensitive information about the user, such as their habits or preferences.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The mobile app may inadvertently share health logs with unauthorized third parties due to misconfigurations or vulnerabilities in the app's sharing settings.

title: Data Breach
description: The health log store may be vulnerable to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive health information.

title: Insecure Data Transmission
description: Health logs may be transmitted over insecure channels, making them susceptible to interception by malicious actors.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The health log store may retain data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure in case of a data breach.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The mobile app may inadvertently share GPS location data with unauthorized parties due to insufficient access controls or vulnerabilities in the app.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: GPS location data may be intercepted during transmission to the location history store, leading to potential exposure of sensitive user information.

title: Inadequate Data Retention Policies
description: The location history store may retain GPS data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse of the data.

title: User Unawareness of Data Usage
description: Users may not be adequately informed about how their location data is used, leading to a lack of consent and potential privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The health log store may inadvertently share sensitive health data with unauthorized parties during the data transfer process.

title: Inadequate Data Anonymization
description: The analytics service may not adequately anonymize the data, leading to the potential identification of individuals based on their health logs.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of health logs from the store to the analytics service, which could expose sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Retention
description: The analytics service may retain health data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or breaches.

title: User Unawareness of Data Usage
description: Users may be unaware of how their health data is being used by the analytics service, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The location history data may be shared without proper consent from the user, leading to unauthorized access to personal movement patterns.

title: Inaccurate Data Interpretation
description: The analytics service may misinterpret the location data, leading to incorrect conclusions about the user's health or behavior, which could affect the user's privacy and trust.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The health analytics service may retain location data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of sensitive information.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: During the transmission of location data, there is a risk of interception by unauthorized parties, leading to potential privacy breaches.

title: Inferred Insights Misinterpretation
description: The health analytics service may provide insights that are misinterpreted by the companion mobile app, leading to incorrect health assessments or actions by the user.

title: Data Misuse by App
description: The companion mobile app may misuse the inferred insights for purposes other than intended, such as selling user data or using it for targeted advertising.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of insights from the health analytics service to the companion mobile app, potentially exposing sensitive health information to unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The app may inadvertently share sensitive health data with unauthorized third parties due to misconfigurations or lack of proper access controls.

title: Inaccurate Data Interpretation
description: The user may misinterpret the trends and indicators displayed by the app, leading to incorrect self-diagnosis or unnecessary anxiety about their health.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data transmitted from the app to the user may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive health information.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The health analytics service may inadvertently share sensitive health data with the cloud hosting provider without proper consent from the data subjects.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Analytics data and health datasets may be intercepted during transmission to the cloud hosting provider, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Inadequate Data Protection Measures
description: The cloud hosting provider may not implement sufficient security measures to protect the stored health data, leading to potential breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The cloud hosting provider may retain health data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.
